svg.title: ARMOR-NODE-SOLAR architecture
svg.desc: The firmware of ARMOR-NODE-SOLAR talks to Voltronic inverters, Pylontech batteries and ANT-BMS batteries through ten serial ports, turns what they say into the messages ARMOR-COMMON accepts and serves a web panel. It has never run on a board and no inverter or battery has been connected.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif
'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: Reads the inverter and the batteries of a solar installation and says what they say, never writing to the inverter, and to a battery only behind three locks.
